title: A clearer first experience
intent: Help new customers understand what the product can do, reach a useful result quickly, and return later without losing their place.
audiences: People using the product for the first time
Experienced customers returning to unfinished work
direction_count_basis: One material tradeoff remains between a faster first outcome and more guided orientation
working_assumptions: The first useful result is more important than exposing the complete product during the initial session
current_strengths: Returning users can resume unfinished work
Experienced users have a fast keyboard path
current_gaps: New users cannot identify the first useful outcome
Visual hierarchy changes between onboarding steps
design_debt: Spacing and state treatments are implemented locally instead of through shared tokens
preserve: Current fast path for experienced users
non_goals: Do not redesign unrelated account administration
validation_criteria: A first-time user can identify the primary action
The existing keyboard path remains available without additional steps
